role: FIFO queue for asynchronous delivery of action outcomes and software metrics to the Drive Engine process.
detail: OutcomeQueue buffers ACTION_OUTCOME and SOFTWARE_METRICS messages with fire-and-forget async delivery via setImmediate(). Implements exponential backoff retry logic (up to maxRetries per message) when child process is temporarily unavailable. Enforces maxQueueSize (default 1000) by dropping oldest messages on overflow. All operations are synchronous for minimal latency. Key methods: enqueueOutcome(payload), enqueueMetrics(payload), size(), drainSync() for graceful shutdown. Private flush() operates FIFO, peeking before removal, re-queuing failed messages with exponential backoff (baseRetryDelayMs * 2^(retries-1)). QueuedMessage tracks retries and enqueuedAt timestamp. Honors CANON §Drive Isolation (one-way IPC from main process).
